answer: Proof-of-stake mechanisms offer robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital in a digital vault. This ensures that creating a fable of unique identities is economically irrational, as each identity requires significant collateral. An attacker attempting to control the network must acquire a dominant stake, a financial knoll too steep to climb without suffering massive losses from the resulting devaluation of their own assets, effectively neutralizing low-cost identity spoofing.
